name: nfsen-ng-nfcapd
description: NetFlow / sFlow / IPFIX collector (nfcapd) for nfsen-ng. It runs the nfcapd daemon from the nfsen-ng image, listening on a UDP port and writing rotated flow files that the nfsen-ng web UI reads. Point your router/switch flow exporter (pfSense/OPNsense/MikroTik/…) at this host on the collector port (default 9995/UDP). Mount this container on the SAME appdata path as the nfsen-ng UI, and make sure the write directory's last path segment (default "flows") matches one of the UI's Sources. This container has no web interface.

paths.name: Data (profiles)
paths.description: Same data directory the nfsen-ng UI reads. nfcapd writes into live/source under it.

ports.name: Collector port
ports.description: UDP port nfcapd listens on. Configure your router's NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX exporter to send here.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone. Should match the UI container.
